Date: 06-05-2021 
 
To 
 
All ACC/ACC (HQ)(Zone) 
 
RPFC/OIC of ROs 
 
Sub:  Payment of EPF benefits to subscribers payment bank account-Reg. 
Ref:  Bkg.1(4)2010/online remittance/Vol II/pt/ 383 dated 27.02.2019 
 
Sir/Madam, 
 
In reference to above subject, banking section had issued directions vide above referred 
letter dated 27.02.2019 to not settle amount in payment banks after seeking clarification from 
RBI. 
 
Now, RBI has included two payment banks namely India Post Payments Bank Limited 
and Fino Payments Bank Limited in the second schedule to the Reserve Bank of India Act,1934. 
 
In view of the above, as above two payments bank qualify under provision of Para 72(e) 
EPF scheme, all ZOs/ROs are advised that payment be settled in the above mentioned scheduled 
commercial payment banks. 
           (This issues with approval of competent authority) 
Yours faithfully, 
 
-sd-               
(Neeraj Srivastava) 
Regional P.F. Commissioner-I (Banking)

The RPFC-I(IS) for taking information and necessary action.
